title: Topology Optimization — Cantilever Beam

context.content: Cantilever beam discretized with 80×40 quadrilateral elements. Unit point load applied at tip. SIMP penalization power p=3.0, target volume fraction 0.3. SLSQP optimizer, max 200 iterations, convergence tolerance 1e-4.

results.content: Optimization completed in 47 iterations. Compliance converged to 42.3 N·mm. Final volume fraction 0.301 (within 0.33% of target). Two primary load paths identified.

synthesis.content: Optimal topology transfers load from tip to root through two primary load paths forming a truss-like structure. Material concentrates along tension-compression members with 0.3 volume fraction. Design is 70% lighter than solid baseline with controlled compliance penalty.

limitations.content:
1. Linear elastic analysis only — no plasticity or geometric nonlinearity
2. Manufacturing constraints not applied (overhang, minimum member size)
3. Mesh convergence study incomplete (coarse 5k elements only)
4. Single load case — multi-load case topology may differ
5. Isotropic material assumption — orthotropic behavior not modeled

recommendations.content:
1. Validate with medium (15k) and fine (50k) mesh convergence study
2. Apply manufacturing constraints for additive manufacturing (overhang angle < 45°)
3. Run multi-load case optimization with 3 load scenarios
4. Consider thermal loads for high-temperature application
5. Fabricate prototype and validate with DIC strain measurement

references: Sigmund, O. (2001). A 99 line topology optimization code. SMO, 21(2), 120-127.
Andreassen, E. et al. (2011). Efficient topology optimization in MATLAB. SMO, 43(1), 1-16.
